upstream.description: An agent-managed museum exhibit, built in Rust with Gajae-Code / LazyCodex — developed and maintained with no human intervention.

classification.analysis: Claw Code is a Rust CLI agent harness (the `claw` binary) explicitly billed by its own README as an agent-managed 'museum exhibit' rather than a serious product, developed and maintained autonomously by AI harnesses (LazyCodex, Gajae-Code) with no direct human intervention. It provides a terminal coding-agent interface with sessions, doctor/health checks, and multi-provider auth (Anthropic, OpenAI keys), positioned as a curiosity/experiment in fully agent-run software maintenance rather than a tool end users should adopt for real work. Actively and continuously pushed by automated agents, with extensive internal goal-tracking and quality-gate logs.

use_cases.title: Inspect an example of a fully agent-maintained CLI codebase
Study Rust CLI architecture for a coding-agent terminal tool
Reference an agent-governance / goal-tracking ledger pattern (.omx)
